scope: Fifty Phase E-I PNG research candidates in the Starlight character and lifecycle study.

auditor.inspection_method: Full exported PNGs inspected with the local image viewer; hashes and dimensions measured from disk.

prompt_receipt_boundary.generation_route: OpenAI image_gen conversation tool, reported by the execution lane; the atomic tool receipt was not persisted beside the exports.
prompt_receipt_boundary.warning: Visual intent summaries are non-authoritative. They are not reconstructions of the exact generation prompts.

advancement_policy.finding: An asset may not advance beyond research unless the exact prompt or edit instruction, tool and model, timestamp, references, output path, and SHA-256 are persisted atomically at generation time.
advancement_policy.current_result: All fifty remain research candidates even where the diagnostic quality score reaches 26/30.
advancement_policy.human_gate: Maker or automated scoring cannot approve a visual. Founder review, meaningfully different comparison, crop checks, and surface QA remain required.
